item.title: AD Mortgage opens $417M securitization to investors
item.description: The transaction is the 28th issued by the company that involves its own collateral, and it's the 19th offering to be rated by Fitch Ratings using collateral originated and serviced by AD Mortgage under its Imperial Fund Mortgage Trust.

item.title: Smarter infrastructure funding strategies for homebuilders
item.description: Formal agreements and smarter phasing allow builders to defer, share, and recover infrastructure costs in tight markets.

item.title: Kind Lending appoints Brett Stubbs as CFO
item.description: Kind Lending appointed Brett Stubbs as chief financial officer, with current CFO Gary Fabian set to retire at the end of 2025.

item.title: PulteGroup forecasts longer-lasting home design trends for 2026
item.description: PulteGroup’s 2026 Design Trends Forecast predicts longer-lasting home design trends, with a focus on multigenerational living, wellness, and quality. The report notes a move toward intentional, anti-consumerist choices.

item.title: Tech100 2025 winners drive AI innovation in mortgage and real estate
item.description: Tech100 2025 winners advanced AI-driven appraisal, agent, servicing and location tools. Companies expanded reach, partnerships and product features in 2025.

item.title: Atlas VMS integrating AI review tool into AIM-Port platform
item.description: The move aims to reduce manual review work for lenders and appraisal management companies while improving consistency and appraisal quality.

item.title: Ohio housing markets tighten as inventory drops 24% below national average
item.description: Ohio’s median home price reached $279,000, up 5.3%, as active inventory rose 22.1% and price cuts hit 45.1% in November.

item.title: Has homeownership become a luxury good?
item.description: First-time buyers now make up only 21% of home purchases, with the median age rising to 40 and the under-35 homeownership rate at 37.1%.

item.title: Zillow expects calmer 2026 housing market, improved affordability
item.description: Home values declined in half of the largest markets analyzed by Zillow in 2025, as of October. That number is projected to drop to 12 in 2026.

item.title: Inventory, affordability take center stage in House hearing
item.description: The hearing focused heavily on interpretations of Build America, Buy America (BABA) requirements and their impacts on affordable housing development.
